title: eludite/nuget/icon
description: Fetch a package's icon into the host's cache folder (`<cache>/nuget-icons/`, the address's SHA-256 as the name), for the Manage NuGet Packages window: asked lazily for the rows that show, never at startup. A `file:` address (a folder feed) answers its own path; an http(s) address is downloaded once per session with a 10 s timeout and a 1 MiB cap (the host's own HTTP client, the system proxy). A failure answers `path: null`.

url.description: The icon's address (`iconUrl` of a search result).

path.description: Absolute path of the cached image, or null when it could not be fetched.
